notes: SOURCE: evening sky of floating sand isles with coconut palms, finite, fixed Sun, no night; ~15 % Earth gravity; winds below hold the isles over the abyss; isles of sand, dirt and rock drift slowly, 5 m to 6 km, palms in the middle about half the isle's width tall; larger isles near the centre with grass, bushes, rare flowers, crickets; rain and moderate wind common; the Lost Suns on the largest isle (Iroquois-style longhouses, tree houses, coconut-tree huts, one public house; palm-bark bows, palm spears, shared coconuts; neutral, house newcomers); the Barrier at the border: stronger gravity, no isles beyond, loud noises, anxiety; extremely small chance of no-clipping to Level 37 or Level 140 deep in it. ADAPTATION: distances compressed: the largest isle is 144 x 124 m, the Barrier begins 250 m east of it and its outermost isle sits at x 295 (page: ~200 km); 15 walkable isles plus ~50 distant ones (page: ~2,000); palms on the largest isle are 13-24 m (page proportion would be ~70 m); bridges absent, isles reached by low-gravity jumps (jump 3.3 m/s, ~20 m sprint leaps); drift amplitudes 1-4 m over 3-5 minutes; rain showers 1-2 minutes every 3-5 minutes; Barrier gravity rises to 5 m/s2; the no-clip is a 1-in-150 roll per 6 s attempt of pushing into the rock lip on the outermost isle's east rim (QA fixture: start on that isle with the roll forced to Level 37); Lost Suns residents not modelled; falling below -120 m into the abyss is fatal.
entity_policy: Coconut Snares (Entity 61) are the only entity; the page gives only their habitat (palms of the smaller, farther isles) and hunting, so they are not shown: crowns rustle, the public house holds drawings of them. Crickets are ambience. The Lost Suns are a friendly, neutral community shown by their houses, fires, stores and notes (no figure models). No combat.
